name: velo
description: Make narrated videos with Velo's agent: explainers, product demos, pitch and launch videos, and social clips from a brief, a document, a screen recording, a website or an AI presenter.

interface.longDescription:
Velo makes finished, narrated videos: explainers, product demos, pitch and launch videos, motion graphics and social clips. Start one from a short brief, a document or deck, a screen recording, a public website, or an AI presenter, then follow it, answer Velo's questions, review the script, change the draft and export the final video without leaving the conversation.

You sign in with your Velo account, and videos are made in your Velo workspace. Making and changing videos uses that workspace's existing credits.
defaultPrompt: Make a 60-second explainer about our new onboarding flow.
Turn the attached pitch deck into a narrated video.
What's the status of my latest Velo video?

positive.description: Start a video from a brief
positive.prompt: Make a 60-second explainer video about how our app's onboarding works, for new customers.
positive.expected_behavior: Starts a video with a short brief, follows it while Velo works, and shows Velo's first question in full without writing a script or answering for the user.

positive.description: Start a video from an attached document
positive.prompt: Turn the attached pitch deck into a narrated video.
positive.expected_behavior: Passes the attached PDF to Velo, starts a video from the document, and shows Velo's first question or progress.

positive.prompt: Show me the script for my latest Velo video.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the latest video and shows every scene of the script word for word, then waits for the user's approval instead of approving it.

positive.prompt: Which narration voices can I use in Velo?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the voices by name, grouped as the user's own, shared in the workspace and public, with a link to Velo's voice library.
Renders the latest draft, follows it until it's done, and gives the links to the finished video.

negative.prompt: What's the weather in Paris tomorrow?

negative.description: Deleting videos, which Velo's tools don't do
Buying credits, which happens only in Velo
negative.prompt: Buy 500 more Velo credits for me.

review.commerce_description: Velo sells nothing in the conversation. Making and changing videos uses credits from the user's existing Velo workspace.

publication.release_notes: First release: make, follow, edit and export Velo videos.
